parameters.content:
## 1 · Website trigger
The careers page sends a multipart POST request here. The webhook responds immediately so the browser does not wait for AI or recruiter approval.

After importing, publish the workflow and copy the **Production URL** into the frontend configuration.

## 2 · Credentials
Select your own OpenAI credential in **OpenAI Chat Model**. Select your own Gmail credential in all three Gmail nodes.

Replace `REPLACE_WITH_RECRUITER_EMAIL` in Recruiter Approval with your presenter inbox. Credentials are intentionally not included in this template.

## 3 · Decision record
The final Code nodes produce an audit record visible in the execution. For durable production storage, add a Data Table Insert Row node after each audit node and map these output fields.
